# `external_directory`

> Profile: deferred · Permission key: `[permission] external_directory`

Access files outside the project directory (requires permission)

Deferred tools are not advertised on every request. Activate one with `tool_search` or set `session.tool_profile = "full"`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | one of `read`, `list` | yes | Action to perform: 'read' to read a file, 'list' to list a directory |
| `path` | string | yes | Path to the external file or directory |
